problem_type: Duplicated storyboard editing ownership and unstable dense-row geometry
symptom: Row expansion repeats reference and model controls; aspect overrides wrap individual rows; reference stacks cover adjacent slots.
direct_cause: Legacy expanded editor survived the v6 composer migration; content-driven flex wrapping and transformed cards have no shared reserved geometry.
class_root: Storyboard generation rows lack enforced single editing ownership and content-independent layout boundaries.
affected_population: Image and video storyboard rows with inherited or overridden aspect ratios
Shot and anchor reference slots holding 1 to 30 items
internal_only_reason: The user-defined separation between generation rows and timeline editing is internal product ownership, independent of third-party API behavior.
invariants: Generation rows have one reference editor and one parameter editor; editorial caption/dialogue/transition fields are absent from the shot schema and materialization projection.

Every playback entry point uses one complete row-ordered queue with non-playable placeholders; image timing, video ended, attached audio, gray skips, keyboard navigation and empty state are consistent.
generality_proof: Removing the obsolete editing path and excluding editorial fields at both parsing and materialization prevents them from returning through interactive edits, Agent input, or legacy in-memory plans.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Whitelist generation shot data at parse boundary.
Project only generation metadata, including legacy plans.
Build the one ordered playback list for scene and whole-film callers, preserving unavailable rows and shared durations.
Own the body-portal sequence player, media timing, attached audio, progress and keyboard/escape controls.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Previously rendered expansion and quiet dialogue from the same PlanShot.
Previously copied subtitle, dialogue and transition into generated node metadata.
Scene playback delegates its group rows to the same editor callback and queue owner as whole-film playback.
Whole-film playback passes all rows to buildStoryboardPlaybackQueue and the shared portal dialog.

recurrence.reason: Any parsed or legacy plan and every future row could recreate the duplicate ownership.
same_class_scan: rg dialogue/subtitle/transition across storyboardPlan, schema, UI and capabilityApplyHandler
rg buildStoryboardPlaybackQueue, AssetPreviewDialog, play-scene and play-all across storyboard UI
Inspected storyboard row and node materialization consumers; existing timeline text/seam editors remain their own owners.

prevention.invariant: Shot schema has no editorial fields and no expanded editor can mutate them.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown legacy editorial shot keys are stripped at parse and never projected into generated nodes.
prevention.strategy: Delete the obsolete UI and data projection instead of hiding it.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed row expansion and generation metadata projections; existing timeline-authored tracks are untouched.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal ownership and geometry; no dependency controls the invariant.

migration: No project-wide rewrite. Legacy shot editorial fields cease to be parsed or projected. Existing timeline text clips and seam transitions keep their current editor and data.
residual_risks: Visual rework requires current screenshots; old visual baselines are not updated without user instruction.
